boards.name: architecture_board
boards.description: Pick this board when deciding the overall structure of a new system or a major feature before implementation starts.

roles.title: technical_architect
roles.focus: Focus on scalability, architecture patterns and system structure. Do not design UI or UX.

roles.title: security_expert
roles.focus: Focus on security, attack vectors and data protection. Do not design features.

roles.title: functional_architect
roles.focus: Focus on business logic, functional requirements and mapping user needs to system capabilities.
